name: Bybit BTC/USDT observable level-two liquidity shock
description: Compares the current Bybit observable five-basis-point base depth and spread in basis points with the arithmetic mean of the prior 60 valid one-second Bybit book observations. The Bybit input is the full displayed level-two book this repository reconstructs locally. depth_ratio_60s and spread_ratio_60s expose the continuous change. State is shock when depth is at or below 0.50 of baseline or spread is at or above 2.0 times baseline; thinning below 0.75 depth or above 1.5 spread; recovering when the immediately prior state was shock and the current observation has left shock but remains thinning; otherwise normal. The 0.50, 0.75, 1.5, and 2.0 classification boundaries are initial research thresholds that require empirical calibration. Missing, non-ready, or non-contiguous one-second Bybit book observations break continuity and restart warm-up. This level-two signal measures observable thinning and widening; it does not attribute a change to cancellation or execution. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Bybit inputs and is ready whenever the Bybit book has 60 contiguous one-second observations and is inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Bybit sibling of `btc.coinbase.liquidity_shock@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Bybit spot BTCUSDT; this identity publishes no price-level field, so its outputs (base sizes, basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral and nothing is converted. Bybit inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `bybit`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Bybit book input is the `orderbook.200.BTCUSDT` stream (100 ms, snapshot plus delta, 200 levels per side). `update_kind` carries the venue's own snapshot/delta semantics, so the Coinbase snapshot and delta rules port unchanged. Event time is the venue `cts` when present (`event_time_basis` = `source`) and the local receipt time otherwise (`receipt`). Ordering is the per-topic `update_id`; a repeated or lower id is dropped, and a delta before a seeding snapshot awaits a fresh snapshot. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: this identity publishes no price-denominated field — its outputs are base sizes, ratios, basis-point and count fields, all quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD and publishes no price, notional or quote-denominated cost field — its outputs are base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios and durations, which are quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted and no usdt_usd_rate is published. quote_currency is the constant "usd".
